definitions.full: H1888. ha הָא demonstrative particle lo! behold! (Biblical Hebrew הֵא (twice); Egyptian Aramaic and Têma הא (Cooke 193, 198 ); הָא ᵑ7 ; Syriac ; Mandean הא (Nö M 81 ); Arabic in Aramaic also often prefixed to pronoun 3 person for greater definiteness, as הָהוּא ᵑ7 , (for h¹-h¥ ), see Nö M 89 f. W CG 106 f. ), Dan 3:25 . הֵא demonstrative particle , prefixed idiomatically to כְּ for greater definiteness, literally behold like (Biblical Hebrew הֵא , see הָא above), only in דִי הֵאכְּֿ Dan 2:43 מִתְעָרַב לָא פַרְזְלָא דִי הֵאכְּֿ like as iron doth not mingle with clay (compare a. ᵑ7 Onk כְמַיָּא הָא Gen 49:4 , so ᵑ7 Jon כ ׳הא Isa 5:28 ; 9:4 + often; ᵑ7 Jer כ ׳הֵי Gen 26:4 , 18 , 22 + often; הֵיח Psa 2:9 ; 5:10 ; Psalm 5:13 +, also pleonastic כְּ ׳הֵיח 22:14 ; 22:15 ; 22:17 +? b. Palmyrene הֵיח as (Lzb 259 ), as בנמוסא היך as (is) in the law (Cooke 321 ; so ᵑ7 Jer Psa 2:9 , etc.), דִּי הֵיח conjecture (like Daniel דִי כְּ הֵא : = Hebrew כַּאֲשֶׁר ), as גבא די היך like as he levied, Cooke Tariff ii. b 12. 18, c 14. 17. 21. 26 [ ᵑ7 Onk Jon for כַּאֲשֶׁר have ᵑ7 דְ, ׳כְּמָא Jer ᵑ6 דְ, ׳הֵיכְמָא . ]. It is dubious whether דִי כְּ הֵא belongs to a (notice especially ᵑ7 Jon ) or b: Schulth ZAW 1902, 164 f. to b. reading דִּי הֵאח (but א rare and late: D (2) § 45. 1); Nes OLtz. 1892, 488 from הֵיח (see Biblical Hebrew) how ? ).
